name: B10-0501/2026 (ECR) – Ukrainian children forcibly deported to Russia or living in Russian-occupied territories in Ukraine
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Ukrainian children forcibly deported or living in Russian-occupied territories in Ukraine
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on Russia to stop taking Ukrainian children to Russia or Russian-held areas and to return them to their families. It says these actions amount to genocide and asks EU countries to say so officially. It wants Russia to say where the children are, to stop putting them up for adoption and to stop forcing Russian schooling and military training on them. It also asks for more EU sanctions and for the children's return to be part of any future peace deal.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament is stating its position and making demands, not passing law.
- **Who it affects:** Ukrainian children taken to Russia or living under Russian occupation, and their families.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to EU institutions, member states, Ukraine, the US, Russia and Belarus.
